name: RFsim
description: S-parameter simulation of PCB structures with openEMS
description_full: Select one or two pads in the PCB editor and simulate S-parameters (S11/S21, Smith chart, VSWR, group delay) with the openEMS FDTD solver. Board geometry and stackup are converted directly from KiCad data to CSXCAD primitives; results are saved as Touchstone files. Requires openEMS, scikit-rf, matplotlib and h5py installed into KiCad's Python (see README).
